Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Research Nurse Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Research Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Nurse position at ACTREC is scheduled for 26 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they arrive at the venue with all necessary documents before the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Research Nurse post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Nurse position, candidates must possess either a B.Sc. in Nursing or a Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery. The qualification must be registered with the Indian Nursing Council (INC) or Maharashtra Nursing Council (MNC).

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the ACTREC Research Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Nurse position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Nurse position varies based on the qualification. Candidates with a GNM qualification will receive Rs. 28,000/- per month, while those with a B.Sc. Nursing qualification will receive Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Nurse post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Research Nurse position at ACTREC. This recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies for verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ACTREC Research Nurse recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 410210.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Nurse role at ACTREC?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Nurse position at ACTREC involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Nurse position at ACTREC is a contractual job. Candidates selected will be appointed on a contract basis for the duration of the project or as specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for ACTREC?
faq.answer: The official website for the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) is www.actrec.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates regarding recruitment.
